'''Foundry Four''' was a hidden base, factory and repair yard on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Xorrn]]. The base was a former [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] foundry. It was hidden between the wreckages of [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Core ship/Legends|Core ships]], that got destroyed during the [[Bombardment of Xorrn/Legends|Bombardment of Xorrn]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
The [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] tried to build their traditional [[Geonosian hive|hive spires]] to house Droid foundries on Xorrn. However the thin crust of planet caused hive spires to collapse before any droid could be produced. To counter this, the Geonosians started to excavate the hives instead of erecting them. Just like other foundries, Foundry Four was dug into surface of Xorrn. Before and during the Clone Wars, Foundry Four was a functioning warren of five separate underground factories joined by a central command center. Each factory had two landing shafts for the supply of raw materials and to move out finished products. Furthermore they functioned as exhaust vents for factory waste. The shafts had a depth of four hundred meters, with a corvette-sized landing platform. The landing pads were equipped with four [[Tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor beam emitters]] to assist landing. Only two landing pads remained in service when [[Clan Assembly (Xorrn)|Clan Assembly]] controlled the Foundry. The Control Center was located above a large magma chamber. Previously used as a monitoring station, Clan Assembly used it for meetings.<ref name="Friends" />

==History==
The Geonosians used Xorrn to illegally produce [[Battle droid/Legends|Battle droids]] hidden from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Factories like Foundry Four managed to turn out millions of battle droids. Just after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outbreak]] of the Clone Wars, the Republic discovered the facilities on Xorrn. Turning the planet of Xorrn into a warzone. After various failed [[Battle of Xorrn (Clone Wars)|attempts]], the Republic didn't want to waste anymore resources on capturing the planet. A sector fleet [[Bombardment of Xorrn/Legends|bombarded]] Xorrn from [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbit]], destroying dozens of Core ships in the process. The bombardment significantly damaged Foundry Four. All but two of its landing shafts collapsed.

After the Clone Wars, Separatist refugees from [[Gall]] under Jans Coorsa moved to Foundry Four. They reopened Foundry Four and started to produce replacement parts and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] armaments on order for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|Mercenaries]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was the site of a large-scale [[Battle of Xorrn|battle]].<ref name="Friends" />
